_comment: Frozen schema-version-2 credential used to pin the Poseidon layouts.
The hashes below were produced by this implementation and are pinned so that an
accidental change to field order, encoding or hash arity fails a test instead of
silently breaking every existing credential. The circuit's own Poseidon is the real
authority and packages/circuits asserts against these same values.
identitySecret is derived the way an issuer derives it, from a fixed development
salt and document key recorded below, so the value is reproducible. It is bound to
an issuer and a document and is not a person identifier; see docs/trust-model.md.
The subject is a standard local development test account, not a production wallet.
